files.description: Universal change review rubric: behavior, scope, reuse, architecture, mechanisms, tests, and UI checks.
Architecture principles: where business rules live and how capabilities, interfaces, and shared foundations depend on each other.
Coding conventions for abstraction level, function size, readability, and safety.
Which layer owns a web feature change: views, controllers, data adapters, interface server code.
Shared components and patterns to reuse when composing screens.
UI parity, focus preservation, popup dismissal, compact header reachability, and narrow-screen verification.
How to choose the owning test layer, avoid duplicated coverage, and test behavior rather than implementation.
PostgreSQL schema invariants: surrogate/public IDs, SQL CHECK constraints, covering FK indexes, and shared Drizzle builders.
Shared authorization policy, current server facts under locks, and tenant/workspace isolation.
Delegated MCP tool contracts, OAuth scopes, precondition parity with web, and error containment.
Drafts, save/close/discard semantics, passive whole-section editing, reference workspace reading, and conflict alignment.
